decision: Match the corrected O4a native-calibration selector for the primary O3a/O4a methodological comparison; do not use the O3a initial-calibration hash-stratified selector for this distinct native stage.
superseded_scope: population_firewall.selection_priority for O3a NATIVE_CALIBRATION only; the original stage contract and all completed O3a stages remain immutable

selection.scope: fresh O3a-only native threshold calibration identities
data_allowed: verified primary-scan detector, integer GPS and candidate indicator
verified native-index training-window detector and GPS identities
validated source-frame ledger and public source inventory for complete context
selection.cross_detector_candidate_and_index_start: inclusive; duration plus forbidden interval gap from the approved stage contract
selection.temporal_blocks: Within each GPS modulo stride phase, split maximal contiguous stride-step runs into consecutive full non-overlapping blocks; discard incomplete tails; sort blocks by first and last GPS; greedily reject overlapping blocks.
selection.priority: For B=ceil(target_rows/block_length) and N eligible non-overlapping blocks, prioritize indices floor(i*(N-1)/(B-1)), i=0..B-1; then all unchosen indices in ascending order. For B=1 prioritize index zero.
selection.context_fallback: Check complete symmetric context and exact source-frame ledger provenance in priority order; skip an incomplete block and take the next; require B accepted full blocks.
selection.output_order: Trim accepted rows to the target per detector, then order each detector's rows chronologically; the first floor(target/block_length)*block_length rows define complete bootstrap blocks.

interpretation: Method parity, not a claim that evenly spaced selection is statistically optimal. Hash-vs-uniform selection is reserved for a separately frozen paired sensitivity analysis on both runs.
